_meta.method: Blind review of fresh public YouTube bio and up to 8 recent video titles/descriptions. Labels were assigned from actual channel content, not from prior admission decisions. The source manifest contained prior outcomes, but they were not used as the label.
_meta.evidenceSource: Public InnerTube about data and channel RSS captured for the 60-channel cohort; notes record the decisive evidence for each label.
_meta.limitations: Single independent reviewer; not sealed multi-adjudicator ground truth. Metrics are evidence-review labels.
